Flipper Feature Flag System for Ruby on Rails

 1) Background / Context
The project involves developing a feature flag system compatible with Ruby on Rails applications. Feature flags are crucial in software development, allowing teams to enable or disable specific features dynamically, facilitating staged rollouts and A/B testing without requiring redeployment of the codebase.

 2) Objectives
- To implement an efficient and user-friendly feature flag system.
- To allow flexible control over feature access and usage.
- To ensure seamless integration with existing data stores.
- To provide advanced capabilities such as cascade features, version control, and audit tracking.

 3) Stakeholders & Users
- Developers: Implement and manage feature flags within the application.
- Product Managers: Define and control feature access for testing and deployment.
- Administrators: Oversee feature access, monitor system performance, and manage user permissions.
- End Users: Experience the application features as enabled or disabled by the feature flag settings.

 4) Functional Descriptions
- Feature Control: Enable or disable application features for all users, specific users, groups, or time-based percentages.
- User Interface: Configure and manage feature flags via a command-line interface or web-based UI.
- Data Storage: Integrate with various data stores to maintain performance in storing feature flags seamlessly.
- Cloud Capabilities: Use Flipper Cloud for cascading features across multiple environments, sharing settings, controlling permissions, and maintaining an audit history.
- Rollback Functionality: Quickly revert feature settings if necessary for stability and performance management.

 5) Non-Functional Descriptions
- Performance: The system must efficiently handle feature flag storage and management, regardless of data store.
- Scalability: Support a large number of features and users without performance degradation.
- Security: Ensure secure access and management of feature flags and configurations.
- Usability: Provide an intuitive interface for easy management of feature settings and user permissions.

-- Schema for database: schemabench_0068

CREATE TABLE `features` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `key` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `description` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `index_features_on_key` (`key`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `gates` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `feature_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `key` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `value` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `index_gates_on_feature_id_and_key_and_value` (`feature_id`, `key`, `value`),
  KEY `index_gates_on_feature_id` (`feature_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `gates_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`feature_id`) REFERENCES `features` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `groups` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `description` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `index_groups_on_name` (`name`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `users` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `flipper_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `role` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `index_users_on_flipper_id` (`flipper_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `user_groups` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `group_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `index_user_groups_on_user_id_and_group_id` (`user_id`, `group_id`),
  KEY `index_user_groups_on_user_id` (`user_id`),
  KEY `index_user_groups_on_group_id` (`group_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `user_groups_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `user_groups_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`group_id`) REFERENCES `groups` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `environments` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `description` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `index_environments_on_name` (`name`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `feature_environments` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `feature_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `environment_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `enabled` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `percentage_of_actors` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `percentage_of_time` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `index_feature_environments_on_feature_id_and_environment_id` (`feature_id`, `environment_id`),
  KEY `index_feature_environments_on_feature_id` (`feature_id`),
  KEY `index_feature_environments_on_environment_id` (`environment_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `feature_environments_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`feature_id`) REFERENCES `features` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `feature_environments_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`environment_id`) REFERENCES `environments` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `audit_logs` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `feature_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `user_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `action` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `previous_value` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `new_value` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `ip_address` varchar(45) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `index_audit_logs_on_feature_id` (`feature_id`),
  KEY `index_audit_logs_on_user_id` (`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `audit_logs_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`feature_id`) REFERENCES `features` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `audit_logs_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `permissions` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `resource` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `action` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `index_permissions_on_user_id_and_resource_and_action` (`user_id`, `resource`, `action`),
  KEY `index_permissions_on_user_id` (`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `permissions_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `feature_versions` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `feature_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `version_number` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `snapshot` text NOT NULL,
  `created_by` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `index_feature_versions_on_feature_id` (`feature_id`),
  KEY `index_feature_versions_on_created_by` (`created_by`),
  CONSTRAINT `feature_versions_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`feature_id`) REFERENCES `features` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `feature_versions_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`created_by`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
